test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster.

RS : TU :: TM : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and last letters ⇒ Immediate next letter is written according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Rest of the letters ⇒ No change

​So,

 
• RS : TU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8be1dd016df0cdc4a25271cba7d26d333c6fec45d9b7f4652f85220e76c73f8f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6cd91d5905cb8e96d4c8a2e340502a38b131411c438480c0e66d37662d1604b.png] 

Similarly,

 
• TM : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1890e1246c6a4429beadcf63ca7047b77b2756af5039fb19c76498cc80ffa41.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edf76e06546bc631f0fcd76595697d448fd3a8052c651f9692b19c937eadac05.png] 

Hence, "VO" is the correct answer.
